title: Casting a positive integer to int preserves positivity

ground_truth.statement: For an int, an int cast is the identity, so a positive-int remains positive. The controls include 1 and PHP_INT_MAX.

allowed.reason: The identity cast is genuinely redundant. This correct warning confirms the positive range is retained and is independent of the return-type preservation criterion. https://psalm.dev/docs/running_psalm/issues/RedundantCastGivenDocblockType/

provenance.note: The source suppresses RedundantCast. The fixture keeps the cast and its visible diagnostic; this criterion tests refinement preservation, not cast-redundancy policy.

notes: PHPStan is clean. Mago reports invalid-return-statement at line 7, widening the positive input to int across an identity cast; runtime and integer-cast semantics contradict that report. Psalm reports RedundantCastGivenDocblockType at line 7, which confirms it retains the positive range and correctly objects to redundant syntax. Independent review corrected the initial FP label: that warning is acknowledged at this exact file and line, not suppressed, because this criterion tests return-type preservation. Mago's incorrect return-type diagnostic remains an FP.
